objective: Finish every portfolio product to its evidence-based launch gate, preserve verified live routes, and automatically move conversion-ready products into CEO rollout and marketing operations.
execution_model: Build -> Verify -> Conversion Gate -> Launch -> Rollout -> Measure -> Improve

requirements: Clear value proposition and primary CTA above the fold
Professional responsive layout for phone, tablet and desktop
Product-appropriate high-quality photography, illustration or original branded graphics
Consistent brand typography, spacing, visual hierarchy and accessible contrast
Fast-loading optimized media with descriptive alt text where meaningful
Trust, contact, privacy, terms, refund/cancellation and delivery pages where applicable
No placeholder counters, fabricated testimonials, fake scarcity or unsupported claims
Working lead, enrolment, checkout or quote journey appropriate to the product
Share actions and portfolio cross-promotion where suitable
SEO/social metadata, favicon/app identity and production error handling

rollout.start_when: VERIFIED_CONVERSION_READY or equivalent product-specific verified conversion gate
rules: Ready/live products enter rollout without waiting for unfinished products.
Unfinished products remain in completion lanes and must not be marketed as live.
IZAKHONO CREATE is the creative source of record; IZAKHONO ADS controls distribution.
Campaign publishing remains evidence-gated by a working customer journey.
Paid media spend requires an approved account, budget and spend authority; no silent spend.
Regulated products require product-specific compliance approval before claims or paid distribution.
Use aggregate first-party operational measurement only; no behavioural surveillance, advertising IDs, UTM/referral identifiers or silent tracking.
Marketing assets must accurately portray the product and use appropriate professional imagery/graphics.

portfolio_rule: Every current and future IZAKHONO product inherits this policy unless a signed product-specific exception supersedes it.
